mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages ( meeting_id, participant_id, message_type, event_type, content ) VALUES ( #{meetingId}, #{participantId}, #{messageType}, #{eventType}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, meeting_id, participant_id, message_type, event_type, content, created_at FROM chat_messages WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} ORDER BY message_id ASC
